I have compiled a list of all possible 30-minute slots for Priya and Marcus. I will now post this to the shared workspace for Brad to review against Elena's and David's calendars. I will list the start times of the slots to be clear.

The message for Brad will be: "Hi Brad. I've found the following 30-minute slots when Priya Raman and Marcus Hale are both available next week. Please check these against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which one works for them.

This is a clear and actionable message for my partner. I will use my third action to post it and my fourth action to end the session.
